decision.reason: [ev-bede4495e31b] is a single changelog line filed under Bug fixes. It names the subject (regexp in Path/PathPrefix under matcher v2) and says only that this is now "supported". It doesn't say how such rules behaved before the fix, for example whether they were rejected, failed to match or matched literally. It also doesn't say which router or rule-syntax configurations are exposed, or what happens to an exposed setup if the operator does nothing. The evidence only points to PR #10546, so that PR or the matching migration/rules documentation is needed before applicability and consequence can be written.
